basic_info.description: Located in one of San Francisco's most up-and-coming residential neighborhoods, this property presents an exceptional ground-up development opportunity in the highly sought-after Portola District. Known for its friendly community feel, increasing revitalization, and proximity to McLaren Park, the Portola has quickly become a favorite among homeowners, builders, and investors looking for strong long-term value. This property offers a rare chance to build new construction, making it ideal for developers, investors, or visionary homeowners seeking a custom residence. With a full rebuild required, the site provides a true blank canvas. Bring your architect, builder, and creative vision to design a modern home tailored to today's standards and lifestyle preferences. The potential here is limited only by your imagination and the city's planning guidelines. Don't miss this opportunity to shape a brand-new home in a neighborhood experiencing exciting growth and transformation.
